title: 8 Things a Godly Man's Phone Habits Reveal About His Faith
caption:
Your screen time is basically a confession.

The first thing he reaches for at 6 a.m. What he searches for at 1 a.m. Whether he can leave it in another room. Who he actually texts when it's bad, and whether Scripture opens before the group chat does.

Whoever he feeds first wins the day. Most days it isn't even close.

You don't need a 30-day detox. You need a war with the thing that's already won more mornings than you'd admit.
